## About
Vintage Iron and Restoration is a classic car repair and restoration shop in North Scottsdale. We help owners restore, repair or update muscle cars, antique cars, vintage cars, classic cars, hot rods and roadster era vehicles.
We have our own in-house engine machine shop, so engine work stays under our roof. The work ranges from tuneups and wiring to drivetrain rebuilds, brake upgrades and custom A/C on vintage vehicles.
Give us a call or feel free to stop in. We keep a clean shop and look forward to seeing what you are driving.

## Services
- Engine diagnostics and overhaul: Diagnostics, tuneups, overhauls, valve jobs, fuel injection and performance modifications.
- A/C repair and installs: A/C repair, installs, replacement and charging, including aftermarket installations on vintage vehicles.
- Wire harness and lighting systems: Electrical diagnostics, wire harness replacement, upgrades and lighting systems.
- Clutch and differential rebuilds: Clutches and differentials, from diagnostics and repairs to rebuilds and upgrades.
- Brake upgrades: Drum to power disc conversions, rotor, caliper and pad upgrades, and complete performance brake systems.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Muscle cars, antique cars, vintage cars, classic cars, and hot rod and roadster era vehicles.

Q: Do you work on newer cars too?
A: Yes. Along with vintage work, we do emissions tuning and late model performance work.

Q: Can I just stop by the shop?
A: Please do. We are open Monday through Friday from 6 AM to 4 PM and closed on weekends.
